summary: South Bow Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, containing a press release announcing the timing of its second-quarter 2026 financial results release and an associated conference call and webcast. The results will be released after market close on August 5, 2026, with a conference call the following morning. This is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change. The filing is procedural and does not involve any transaction, strategic review, or corporate action that would classify it as a special situation.
